title: Geometric and operation data for open tensor normalization
statement: For a Cartesian square of open immersions, define the ordinary pro-etale site and its vertical natural-number diagram site, arbitrary coefficient ring sheaves and their structural map, the site square fixing both fibre-product projections, the actual sectionwise restriction and direct-image functors, exact open extensions with their adjunction and section unit, and module pullbacks with their total left-derived presentations [def-cbc-open-immersion-square, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-exact-derived-adjunction]. The Operations record retains the ordinary mate, derived representative equation and pure-tensor normalized restriction comparison using TensorModel [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-restriction]. Assertion records the invertible units, full faithfulness and normalized beta and gamma equations. For constant finite coefficients retain the section/scalar-preserving realizations, ordinary and derived comparison pins, total-tensor representative pins, and the equations of the two finite comparison routes. These are exactly the data formerly defined in lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization, with no added hypotheses or changed conclusions.

lean.note: Existing public data are reexported by OpenTensorNormalization. The two original holed theorems and final theorem remain in their original module. Finite closed-record projections are replaced by their definitionally equal fields to reduce elaboration work. The finite tensor pin uses the equivalent subtype of total comparisons satisfying the original two equations, with named accessors; typed finite tensor and complex aliases avoid repeated kernel expansion.
